messages:
anya: quick thread on nav IA tweaks before the design review. main goal: make deep links predictable and friendly for copy/paste + OG previews
marina: yes. current pain: long nested paths like /orgs/7/p/42/workloads/99/models/3. people lose the path when sharing. we should canonicalize to /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId
kevin: canonical path makes sense. also propose stable aliases for short links (e.g., /m/:modelId) that redirect to canonical path to keep old bookmarks working
shelly: sidebar layout question: do we show both Models and Deploys as separate top-level entries under an "AI" group, or keep them under Workloads with a second-level menu?
\anya: prefer two visible entries under a group header "AI" so users can jump straight to Models or Deploys. group should be collapsible with aria-expanded state
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: add role="navigation" to the leftnav, aria-expanded on toggles, aria-current="page" for active items, and a visible skip link ("Skip to main content") for keyboard users\marina: for breadcrumbs, keep them shallow: Org > Project > Models > Model Name. do not echo the group name if it clutters. show friendly names, fallback to id when missing
kevin: routing detail: use history API + server rewrites so shared links render OG metadata. ops, any concerns about adding lightweight SSR for known entities?
\ops-bot: doable. we'll add a rewrite layer and a small metadata cache that serves og:title/og:description for known ids. need a list of canonical routes so ops can whitelist them\shelly: microcopy: use plural for list pages ("Models"), singular for detail title ("Model: Apollo-v2"). breadcrumbs should use Title Case\anya: deep-link to panels: prefer query params for tab selection (e.g., ?tab=metrics) rather than hashes. keep URL canonical and deterministic
kevin: agree. for internal fragment navigation we can still scroll to anchors on hydration if tab param is present
marina: UX nit: pinned shortcuts in the nav should open canonical URLs (so sharing from a pin produces the same OG preview). show a subtle toast "Opened from your shortcuts" when opening from a pin\a11y-bot: ensure pinned region has role:list and keyboard traversal works. announce to screen readers when a pin is opened via aria-live region\ops-bot: action items for infra: 1) add rewrite rules for /m/:id and /d/:id aliases 2) provide a small metadata cache endpoint 3) whitelist canonical model/deploy routes for SSR meta injection\anya: action items for design/dev: 1) finalize breadcrumb copy rules and fallback behavior (marina) 2) prototype collapsed AI group with keyboard behavior (shelly) 3) add redirect map for legacy links (kevin) 4) a11y checklist + e2e keyboard tests (a11y-bot)\marina: thanks — I'll capture these in the design doc and bring a quick demo to the review at 4pm :thumbsup:
